title: Hacker Trends: North Korean Groups Utilizing AI for Attacks
description: Recent reports indicate that North Korean hackers are employing artificial intelligence to enhance their cyber operations, according to cybersecurity news sources.

sources.title: Kimsuky Builds Offline AI Stack to Boost Phishing and Automate Malware Development
North Korea’s hackers using AI for attacks, cybersecurity firm says
North Korean spies are running local LLMs to cause AI mischief

sections.heading: Kimsuky's AI Development
paragraphs: According to The Hacker News, the group known as Kimsuky is building an offline AI stack. This development is intended to boost phishing efforts and automate the creation of malware.

sections.heading: North Korean Cyber Attacks
paragraphs: Al Jazeera reports that hackers from North Korea are utilizing AI for their attacks. This information comes from statements provided by a cybersecurity firm.

sections.heading: Local Large Language Models
paragraphs: The Register states that North Korean spies are operating local Large Language Models (LLMs). These activities are reportedly being used to cause mischief involving AI.

faq.q: What is Kimsuky doing with AI?
faq.a: According to The Hacker News, Kimsuky is building an offline AI stack to boost phishing and automate malware development.

faq.q: Who reported on North Korean hackers using AI?
faq.a: Al Jazeera and The Register have reported on North Korean hackers and spies using AI for attacks and mischief, respectively.

faq.q: What type of AI models are being used?
faq.a: The Register reports that North Korean spies are running local Large Language Models (LLMs).
